question.text: An Investment Policy Statement (IPS) is the foundation for:

answer.text: Policy statement/road map specifying investor objectives, goals, constraints, preferences, and risk appetite, forming the basis for strategic asset allocation

explanation.text: The Logic: The IPS is a policy statement and road map for the investor that records objectives, goals, constraints, preferences, and risk appetite and serves as the basis for strategic asset allocation decisions. The Trap: The IPS is distinct from the PMS client agreement; the agreement defines the rights and obligations of the parties separately. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XXI-B Portfolio Managers workbook, p.163-164.
